e1dbbbf31f00f7f3.summary: A hidden PowerShell command executed on host LAB-PC-07 under user student042 to download an executable file from an external IP address into a public folder.
recommended_actions: Isolate host LAB-PC-07 from the network to contain potential malware execution.
Delete the downloaded file C:\Users\Public\a.exe and terminate any related PowerShell processes on LAB-PC-07.
Force a password reset for user student042 and check for additional compromised activity.

fb33cb253d3736ff.summary: An external IP address successfully logged into the admin account on host SRV-FILE-01 after 214 failed SSH login attempts.
recommended_actions: Block traffic from source IP 198.51.100.77 at the network firewall.
Terminate all active SSH sessions for user admin on SRV-FILE-01 and reset the account credentials.
Investigate process execution and authentication logs on SRV-FILE-01 for malicious post-compromise activity.

5e8668f7963ce106.summary: The account student088 registered successful logins from Malaysia and Romania just 20 minutes apart, which indicates a probable account takeover.
recommended_actions: Revoke all active sessions and force an immediate password reset for user student088.
Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) on the student088 account for all future logins.
Review recent Entra ID and cloud application logs for user student088 to check for unauthorized activity after 16:20.

5204c7779c32cd25.summary: A known trojan malware was downloaded to a lab computer by student150, and the automated antivirus quarantine attempt failed.
recommended_actions: Isolate host LAB-PC-12 from the network immediately.
Manually delete the malicious file C:\Users\student150\Downloads\crack_setup.exe.
Run a full Microsoft Defender scan on LAB-PC-12 to check for further compromise.
Review student150 account activity for any other suspicious actions.

39554f24e53b8b4c.summary: An unknown program launched by Microsoft Word attempted to steal saved passwords from the web browser on staff computer STAFF-PC-03.
39554f24e53b8b4c.mitre_technique: T1555.003 Credentials from Password Stores: Credentials from Web Browsers
recommended_actions: Isolate host STAFF-PC-03 from the network immediately.
Force a password reset for user staff017.
Investigate the file tmp8821.exe and the Word document that spawned it.

f828ee6481025ec9.summary: Laboratory computer LAB-PC-19 used by student073 is consistently communicating with an external IP address every 60 seconds on a non-standard port, indicating potential command-and-control beaconing.
recommended_actions: Isolate host LAB-PC-19 from the university network immediately.
Block destination IP 203.0.113.99 on the firewall.
Review forensic logs and memory dumps from LAB-PC-19 to identify the executing payload.

1ed00f02589510b7.summary: Ransomware activity was detected on server SRV-SHARE-02, where over 3,000 files were rapidly encrypted and renamed with a .locked extension.
recommended_actions: Immediately isolate host SRV-SHARE-02 from the network to stop the spread of ransomware.
Disable the compromised user account svc_backup and terminate the malicious process svc_update.exe on SRV-SHARE-02.
Initiate incident response protocols and assess backup integrity for restoring encrypted data on SRV-SHARE-02.

6dac31dd89a7c22a.summary: A student workstation (LAB-PC-22) conducted a rapid port scan against 1,200 ports across a server subnet within two minutes.
recommended_actions: Contact user student099 or the lab supervisor to determine if port scanning from LAB-PC-22 is part of an approved lab exercise.
Isolate workstation LAB-PC-22 (10.0.8.44) from the network if the activity is unauthorized.
Check server subnet traffic logs for any follow-on exploitation or unauthorized connections originating from LAB-PC-22.

1688b56b3876c6cd.summary: A student account experienced 18 failed VPN login attempts within 10 minutes from an external IP address, indicating a potential brute-force or password guessing attempt.
recommended_actions: Check logs on VPN-GW-01 to confirm whether student117 had any successful logins following the failed attempts.
Inspect VPN-GW-01 logs to determine if external IP 203.0.113.141 is attempting to authenticate against other user accounts.
Contact user student117 to verify if the login attempts were legitimate and consider enforcing a password reset if compromised.

dd2679f832f77005.summary: An administrative account logged into the domain controller SRV-AD-01 via RDP at 3:12 AM from an unrecognized device without an associated change ticket.
recommended_actions: Contact user it.admin2 immediately to confirm if the 3:12 AM login to SRV-AD-01 from NEW-DEVICE-99 (10.0.9.200) was legitimate.
If unconfirmed, revoke active sessions for user it.admin2 and reset the account password.
Inspect host NEW-DEVICE-99 and source IP 10.0.9.200 for signs of unauthorized access or compromise.

45f65f7d0ca22002.summary: Student user student201 clicked a link in a phishing email and submitted sensitive information on a fake login page.
recommended_actions: Force a password reset and revoke all active authentication sessions for user student201.
Check authentication logs for student201 to detect any successful unauthorized sign-ins following the credential entry.
Block the phishing domain apu-login.example-verify.test on the web security gateway and email firewall.

ae2a734ed6f35409.summary: User student030 experienced three failed login attempts on workstation LAB-PC-04 before successfully logging in, which is consistent with normal password mistyping.
recommended_actions: Confirm with student030 whether they simply mis typed their password on host LAB-PC-04.
Close this alert in Splunk SIEM as a false positive user error.

6333ffdf6aed897a.summary: An IT administrator ran an inventory script on IT-PC-01 referencing an approved change ticket.
recommended_actions: Verify change ticket CHG-1042 in the change management system to confirm scheduled IT maintenance by it.admin1.
Close the alert as a false positive once the change ticket is verified.

11fd89db624a01c0.summary: The Windows Update process (TiWorker.exe) on machine LAB-PC-03 launched a command prompt to execute a standard Windows Update detection command. This is expected system behavior during update activity.
recommended_actions: Verify that routine Windows patching was scheduled on LAB-PC-03 around 01:15 AM.
Tune or close the suspicious child process detection rule in Microsoft Defender for standard Windows Update binaries.

8509e4e394d563a9.summary: internal vulnerability scanner SCAN-01 performed an authorized routine port scan against the lab subnet using service account svc_nessus.
recommended_actions: Confirm that the scan by svc_nessus on host SCAN-01 corresponds with the standard vulnerability management schedule.
Verify that host SCAN-01 is restricted to authorized scanner tasks and has not been altered.

e9b8d4a5d7e8d3dc.summary: A large data transfer of 8.1 GB occurred from the backup server SRV-BACKUP-01 to an external IP address overnight, which matches an approved nightly backup schedule.
recommended_actions: Confirm that destination IP 203.0.113.20 belongs to the approved external backup provider.
Verify that the backup job timing and data volume align with normal operations for SRV-BACKUP-01.

818e759ca985dec6.summary: Microsoft Defender blocked a potentially unwanted game launcher (Presenoker) from running on lab computer LAB-PC-15 for user student064.
recommended_actions: Confirm in Microsoft Defender console that the file on LAB-PC-15 was successfully blocked and quarantined.
Notify student064 regarding university policy on unapproved software and game launchers if necessary.

16bfc9c536ca63d8.summary: User student110 on host LAB-PC-18 made a DNS request for a domain that resolves to a known legitimate software update distribution network.
recommended_actions: No immediate containment action is required for host LAB-PC-18 as the activity is associated with normal software updates.
Optionally review update settings or software installed on LAB-PC-18 if domain alerts persist.
